answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-sensor-presence. A grove of beacons each broadcasts a fresh random kernel every 30 seconds; an agent must capture that kernel through its own microphone and return it signed inside a hardware oasis, a secure enclave the private key never leaves. A second identity forces a second enclave plus 30s of live capture per beacon, and one microphone cannot parallelize across many kernels, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand devices and 8+ hours of recording. Check: replay each signed kernel against the beacon log; any reused or stale kernel is rejected.
